precision_and_formula.identity_tail: Each of two RQS layers returns its input exactly for value>8. All registered configs use bound=8; hence recorded b>8 implies base(b)=b without evaluating conditioner nets.
precision_and_formula.zero_interpretation: Observed zero is a saved floating-point value. Mathematical logistic tail is strictly positive; log-domain upper bounds avoid inventing a representable nonzero probability.
precision_and_formula.margin_definition: Exact float64 difference of two stored float32 values b-z; it does not recover unrecorded infinite-precision preprocessing.
precision_and_formula.no_drop_scope: All eligible UID rows are saved for each model and all logp are checked. Eligibility exclusions precede scoring and are not numerical drops.
precision_and_formula.input_margin_arithmetic: Two separately labeled input metrics: float64(p32)-float64(y32) versus float32(p32-y32). The standardized margin remains float64(saved b32)-float64(saved z32).

limitations: No new model evaluation or float64 refit/replay was performed.
The tail certificate concerns the mathematical logistic function at the saved rounded b.
No uniform guarantee for other events, models, devices, or numerical precision is inferred.
Repeated model-event counts and the two catalogs are not independent optimizer replications; all 20 exact Full rerun pairs are disclosed.
Raw ledger/order reconciliation is an independent companion audit; this audit binds its saved catalog UID hash and component files.

companion_reconciliation.scope: The companion audit reconstructs ordered z/b from frozen pure preprocessing without neural evaluation. Together these checks establish row correspondence; declared UID hashes alone would not prove it.
